name: Lesson 11 · Dates: the months, im, numbers to 100, der dritte Mai

cards.note: Numbers to 100. sechs drops its s before -zig: sechzig, as in sechzehn.
Numbers to 100. sieben drops its -en: siebzig, as in siebzehn.
Numbers to 100. acht + zig, nothing dropped.
Numbers to 100. neun + zig: neunzig.
Numbers to 100. hundert needs no word for a; einhundert is also possible.
Numbers to 100. The unit, und, the ten: fünfundsechzig.
Numbers to 100. neun und neunzig, in one word.
Numbers to 100. The unit keeps its full form, siebenund-; only the ten shortens to siebzig.
Numbers to 100. zwei und achtzig: two-and-eighty.
Numbers to 100. acht und zwanzig. Months take der, so der Februar.
The months, and im for a month. im before a month: im Januar. The months are all der-words.
The months, and im for a month. im Februar: in February.
The months, and im for a month. im März takes the first place; the verb follows.
The months, and im for a month. im April: the verb second, ich after it.
The months, and im for a month. im Mai.

cards.front: **In June** we play a lot of football.
cards.note: The months, and im for a month. im Juni.
The months, and im for a month. im Juli. Juni and Juli sound alike; on the phone people say Juno and Julei.
The months, and im for a month. im August, stressed on the second syllable: Au-GUST.
The months, and im for a month. im September: a time phrase goes before the object.
The months, and im for a month. der Oktober. einunddreißig: one-and-thirty.

cards.front: **In November** I drink a lot of tea.
cards.note: The months, and im for a month. im November.

cards.front: **In December** we eat a lot of cake.
cards.note: The months, and im for a month. im Dezember.
The months, and im for a month. der Monat → Monate, the -e plural.
Dates: der dritte Mai, am dritten Mai. Dates use ordinals: erste, first. German says the first May, with no of.

cards.front: **On the second** of January I'm working.
cards.note: Dates: der dritte Mai, am dritten Mai. After am the ordinal ends in -en: am zweiten.

cards.front: My birthday is **on the third** of June.
cards.note: Dates: der dritte Mai, am dritten Mai. dritte is irregular, like English third: am dritten.
Dates: der dritte Mai, am dritten Mai. Up to 19, the ordinal adds -t-: vier → vierte.

cards.front: When is your birthday? (one friend) – **On the fourth** of August.
cards.back: Wann ist dein Geburtstag? – **Am vierten** August.
cards.note: Dates: der dritte Mai, am dritten Mai. am vierten: -ten after am.

cards.front: **On the seventh** of July my brother is coming.
cards.note: Dates: der dritte Mai, am dritten Mai. sieben drops -en: siebte, am siebten.

cards.front: **On the tenth** of December we're cooking.
cards.note: Dates: der dritte Mai, am dritten Mai. zehn + -t-: am zehnten.
Dates: der dritte Mai, am dritten Mai. From 20 on, the ordinal adds -st-: zwanzigste.

cards.front: **On the thirty-first** of December we eat fish.
cards.note: Dates: der dritte Mai, am dritten Mai. From 20 on, -st-: einunddreißigsten.

cards.front: Is your birthday **on the first** of April? (one friend)
cards.note: Dates: der dritte Mai, am dritten Mai. erste is irregular: am ersten, never einsten.
Dates: der dritte Mai, am dritten Mai. der dritte: after der, the ordinal ends in -e.
Dates: der dritte Mai, am dritten Mai. The month can be left out when it is clear: der siebte.
